segments.text: When was the last time this country
segments.translation: 这个国家上一次承办

segments.text: hosted the Olympic Games?
segments.translation: 奥运会是什么时候？

segments.text: The Olympic Games will be held
segments.translation: 4年后，奥林匹克运动会将

segments.text: in our country in four years' time.
segments.translation: 在我们国家举行。

segments.text: As a great many people will be
segments.translation: 由于届时将有大批人到我国来，

segments.text: visiting the country,
segments.translation: 所以政府将修建一些新旅馆，

segments.text: the government will be building new hotels,
segments.translation: 一座大型体育场，

segments.text: an immense stadium,
segments.translation: 以及一个新的奥运会标准游泳池。

segments.text: and a new Olympic-standard swimming pool.
segments.translation: 他们还将修筑一些新公路和

segments.text: They will also be building new roads
segments.translation: 一条铁路专线。

segments.text: and a special railway line.
segments.translation: 奥运会就在首都市郊举办，

segments.text: The Games will be held just outside the capital
segments.translation: 届时整个地区将被称作

segments.text: and the whole area will be called 'Olympic City'.
segments.translation: '奥林匹克城'。

segments.text: Workers will have completed the new roads
segments.translation: 工人们将在今年年底前把新公路

segments.text: by the end of this year.
segments.translation: 修好。

segments.text: By the end of next year,
segments.translation: 到明年年底，

segments.text: they will have finished work on the new stadium.
segments.translation: 他们将把新体育场建成。

segments.text: The fantastic modern buildings have been designed
segments.translation: 这些巨大的现代化建筑

segments.text: by Kurt Gunter.
segments.translation: 是由库尔特·冈特设计的。

segments.text: Everybody will be watching anxiously
segments.translation: 大家将会焦急地注视着

segments.text: as the new buildings go up.
segments.translation: 各项新建筑的建设进度。

segments.text: We are all very excited and are looking forward to
segments.translation: 我们都非常激动，盼望着奥运会的到来，

segments.text: the Olympic Games because
segments.translation: 因为在这个国家里

segments.text: they have never been held before in this country.
segments.translation: 还从未举办过奥运会。
